verdict.rationale: Swell documents a single API call that returns a store's whole schema at runtime, covering every model with field types and relationships. That is a machine-readable description of the data model, but it is not a downloadable API spec. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, and Swell never claims to publish an OpenAPI file, so the probes show absence rather than contradict a claim. Missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI (or equivalent) spec covering endpoints, operations and auth; independent or hands-on confirmation of the schema call's format and contents.
